company.name: Probook
company.shortDescription: Probook is an AI operating system designed specifically for home services, focusing on optimizing the dispatch process.
company.description: Probook develops AI-powered dispatching software for home service businesses, including HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service providers. Its platform analyzes historical operational and sales data to match technicians with service calls and automate dispatch-related workflows. The software integrates with existing field service management systems and supports tasks such as scheduling, customer communications, and job information verification. Probook is designed to help dispatchers focus on exception handling and other operational activities while reducing manual assignment processes. The company serves home service operators ranging from independent businesses to multi-location organizations.
